title: Qizhi Kebitong Formula Ameliorates Streptozocin-Induced Diabetic Osteoporosis through Regulating the PI3K/Akt/NF-kappaB Pathway.
authors: Tian, Lulu; Ding, Lu; Wang, Guoqiang; Guo, Yu; Zhao, Yunyun; Wei, Yuchi; Li, Xingquan; Zhang, Wei; Mi, Jia; Li, Xiangyan; Wang, Zeyu; Wang, Xiuge
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药复方通过PI3K/Akt/NF-kappaB通路改善糖尿病骨质疏松，仅涉及网络药理学和分子对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Diabetic osteoporosis (DOP) is a progressive osteoblast dysfunction induced by high glucose, which has negative impacts on bone homeostasis. Qizhi Kebitong formula (QKF) is a traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) formula for treating DOP. However, its role in the protection of DOP has not been clarified yet. Here, we aimed to explore the potential mechanisms of QKF on DOP development via in vivo experiment. METHODS: Network pharmacology was used to detect the key targets and signaling pathways of QKF on DOP. The effects of QKF on DOP were examined by the phenotypic characteristics, micro-CT, and hematoxylin-eosin (H&E) staining. The predicted targets and pathways were validated by a streptozocin- (STZ-) induced mouse model. Subsequently, the levels of the selected genes and proteins were analyzed using qRT-PCR and Western blot. Finally, AutoDock and PyMOL were used for molecular docking. RESULTS: In this study, 90 active compounds and 2970 related disease targets have been found through network pharmacology. And QKF could improve the microstructures of femur bone mass, reduce inflammatory cell infiltration, and downregulate the levels of TNF-alpha, IKBKB, IL-6, and IL-1beta. Moreover, the underlying effect of PI3K/Akt/NF-kappaB pathways was also recommended in the treatment. CONCLUSION: Altogether, our findings suggested that QKF could markedly alleviate osteoblast dysfunction by modulating the key targets and PI3K/Akt/NF-kappaB signaling pathway.
abstract_zh: 背景：糖尿病性骨质疏松症（DOP）是由高血糖引起的进行性成骨细胞功能障碍，对骨稳态产生负面影响。芪骨益骨方（QKF）是一种用于治疗DOP的传统中药（TCM）方剂。然而，其在DOP保护中的作用尚未明确。本研究旨在通过体内实验探讨QKF对DOP发生发展的潜在机制。方法：采用网络药理学检测QKF作用于DOP的关键靶点和信号通路。通过表型特征、micro-CT和HE染色检测QKF对DOP的影响。利用链脲佐菌素（STZ）诱导的小鼠模型验证预测的靶点和通路。随后，使用qRT-PCR和Western blot分析所选基因和蛋白的表达水平。最后，采用AutoDock和PyMOL进行分子对接。结果：本研究通过网络药理学发现90个活性化合物和2970个相关疾病靶点。QKF能改善股骨骨量微结构，减少炎症细胞浸润，并下调TNF-α、IKBKB、IL-6和IL-1β的水平。此外，治疗中还推荐了PI3K/Akt/NF-κB通路的潜在作用。结论：总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，QKF通过调节关键靶点和PI3K/Akt/NF-κB信号通路，可显著缓解成骨细胞功能障碍。
